topics.title: BI 4015092 (KRAS G12D Inhibitor) – CRC Development Plan & China Integration

background.text: BI 4015092 is a late follower in KRAS G12D inhibitor space; several competitors at least two years ahead. eTPP targets: 2L+ CRC combo w/ cetuximab (AA, US); 1L CRC combo w/ cetuximab + FOLFOX (FA, US). Development plan includes DE solid tumors, DE 2L+ CRC, backfill cohorts, RDO, pivotal Ph2 2L+ CRC (single arm n=90), DE/RDO 1L CRC, rPh3 1L CRC vs FOLFOX+/-Bev. Risk: if any competitor receives FA in 1L CRC and becomes SoC. SoD for KRAS G12D inh. (BU) CRC noted as 2025 milestone.
background.quote:
Fierce competition in the development of G12D specific KRAS inhibitors
Several competitors are at least two years ahead
Learning from G12C: swift move to early lines and combinations to increase efficacy
Differentiation / BIC profile is needed to succeed

background.text: China integration timeline: Ph I mono DE – CTA Sub Q2/3 2026, CTA Review + EC + HGRAC + 1st SIV Q1 2027; Ph I 2L CRC combo + cetuximab – Pre-IND Sub Q2 2026 (Pre-IND TBD), Global TDO + 1M. Two pending discussion topics: biomarker strategy and IMP shelf life.
background.quote:
Two pending discussion topics:
Biomarker strategy
IMP shelf life

decision.text: HP BUEC endorsed accelerated plans for CRC development (together with HER2m Pantumor) with assumptions/risks.
decision.quote: HP BUEC endorsed the accelerated plans for CRC development and HER2m Pantumor with the assumptions/risks
